rules.name: Name
rules.capacityHelp: Empty means unlimited. Reducing capacity keeps existing manual members. Focus retains four slots.
rules.playingNow: Only games in the Playing status
rules.upcoming: Release date is today or later
rules.upcomingHelp: Uses the current calendar day in {{timeZone}} each time you open it. Unknown or invalid dates are excluded. There is no upper date limit; other filters still apply.
rules.invalidBounds: A minimum cannot be greater than its maximum.
rules.previewError: The preview could not be loaded. Your saved playlist has not changed.
rules.prioritiesHelp: Existing game order, status priorities and exclusions are retained. Status grouping takes precedence over manual game order.

dates.changedReferences: Some references changed during your review. Their old selections were not carried over; review and select those dates again.
dates.timeZone: Time zone for this review: {{value}}. Saved calendar dates are not converted again.
dates.title: Review date references
dates.help: Choose reference dates for empty fields. Nothing is saved until you confirm. Steam activity is not a confirmed story-finish date.
dates.missingLastPlayed: Steam may omit last played for other accounts. When available, the last saved achievement is offered instead, not a confirmed finish date.
dates.loadFailed: The date references could not be loaded. Try reloading them.
dates.unsupported: Update the API to save reviewed dates safely.
dates.empty: No new reliable date references are available. This does not mean you did not play or that every date is filled. You can enter dates manually in the Personal tab.
dates.search: Find a game in date references
dates.firstAchievement: First saved achievement; your first play may have been earlier.
dates.lastPlayed: Last played on Steam; not a confirmed story-finish date.
dates.lastAchievement: Last saved achievement; not a confirmed story-finish date.
dates.kept: Your saved date will be kept.
dates.dismissed: The selected references have been ignored.
dates.partial: Some selected games changed or already have dates. Confirmed saves are retained. Reload to review the rest.
dates.failed: The changes could not be confirmed. Reload before trying again.
dates.savedRefreshFailed: Dates were saved, but the game could not be refreshed. Reload the current data instead of repeating the save.

statistics.startedBasisHelp: Counts saved start dates for games and Replays, not every game played. Steam activity is separate; an unknown date does not mean you did not play.
statistics.finishedBasisHelp: Counts saved finish dates for games and Replays, not your whole library or Steam's last played date. Missing finish dates are not counted in a year.
statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.chartHelp: Choose a month to explore its games.
statistics.emptyUnlocks: No dated unlocks in this period
statistics.chooseAnotherPeriod: Choose another period to explore your collection.
statistics.broadDefinition: A manual mark, preserved completion, a completed Steam set or all current achievements.
statistics.strictDefinition: On Steam, all current required base-game and DLC achievements with a positive total. Without Steam, the manual declaration.
statistics.closureDefinition: A valid closing date on the game or a Replay, without counting the same game twice. A date does not itself activate completion.
statistics.monthlyTimeHelp: The collection stores totals, not dated sessions. Monthly hours require recording when you played; accumulated totals are not distributed across months.
statistics.emptyDates: No stored dates in this period
statistics.dateHelp: These are dates saved on games and Replays, not reconstructed sessions. An explicitly accepted Steam activity reference does not prove a narrative completion and no longer moves when you play again.
statistics.gradeHelp: Each game has one ranking entry using its highest grade in this period. Replays without a grade do not inherit the game's grade. These are currently stored grades, not a reconstruction of past grades.
statistics.gotyQuestion: Which game stayed with you this year?
statistics.gotyHelp: Choose a game with a stored start or closing date in this year, including Replays. It does not need to be a release from this year. Saved GOTY views remain separate.
statistics.studioEmptyHelp: Assign a developer to a game to begin exploring its presence in your collection. Nothing is assigned automatically.
statistics.missingFinish: Completed without a closing date on the game
statistics.missingStory: Games without an estimated story duration

focusPage.full: All slots are occupied. Remove a game to make room for another.
focusPage.managerHelp: Reorder or remove games here. Removing a game from Focus does not delete it from your library.

detail.scoreHelp: Critic ÷ (story hours + 10), rounded as in GDB. It changes only when critic or story duration changes.
detail.createFocusHelp: There is no manual Focus playlist here yet. Create it and add this game only if you want to.

detail.artworkFailed: Steam did not return a usable {{role}} image. Your previous URL has been kept.
